rv.q: There’s a rich seam of detail to Elliot’s production, in the way it carefully shades in all the various relationships, parental and marital, via the choreography of the kitchen table.
For me, the losses far outweigh the gains and the production style is uncertain...

The trouble is the plays, whilst powerful individually, descend into soap opera territory as grim scenario follows after grim scenario like a gloomy EASTENDERS omnibus and after a while it’s hard to care.

cn.t: Mixed reception: critics praise Anne-Marie Duff's performance and Bunny Christie's immersive design, but debate whether merging three DH Lawrence plays into one evening respects the source material.
